items.text: Xbox has a new CEO, a cheaper Game Pass, and a brand-new Xbox Labs. So what's happening to Xbox?
Asha Sharma took over as CEO in February, after Phil Spencer retired.
is Xbox losing its identity or preparing for the future of gaming? I would think it's gonna be a very strong fight with PlayStation.
People will still love to play games.
And Microsoft owns some of the biggest studios in gaming.

Making games is now even more cheaper compared to what we used to have. I think Xbox will have a lot more titles than they used to. They just need to prepare to capture the market before PlayStation guys get them.
